Hi Sarah — thanks, happy to help. Short answer: Marketplace accepts official company registration (certificate of incorporation), a DUNS or similar business identifier, and a primary business address verification. For larger accounts they sometimes ask for a VAT/tax registration depending on region.

For the technical validation we'll run two passes:
- Identity & manifest: we need your publisher name, contact email, and the draft offer manifest (SKU mapping, pricing model). Please send a manifest draft as JSON.
- Endpoint compatibility sweep: we need a reachable staging endpoint and a short test harness (curl commands or a simple request file). We'll check TLS chain, I/O contract for the service, auth header behavior (Bearer/OAuth flow), CORS and response times for a 512-token generation call.

Can you upload: company_certificate.pdf, duns_document.pdf (or equivalent), and a small endpoint-sample-request.txt with 2-3 curl examples? If you can also drop a manifest draft we can pre-validate it against the Azure schema.

Timeline: if we get those by EOD Thu (23 Sep) we can return a pre-validation report within 48 hours and raise any gaps to Azure Marketplace Support to expedite.

I've attached a short checklist and a sample request file (see attachments list below). Looping Marissa for manifest/portal steps and Laura for identity evidence tips.

Attachments referenced: endpoint-sample-request.txt, publisher-evidence-checklist.md

Thanks,
Sean

Sarah — forwarding a quick technical checklist we run on every new publisher. I pulled the most common failure modes so you can avoid rework with Azure during validation. Please upload the files into the Drive folder (link below) and confirm the staging endpoint for the sweep.

Key items we will validate (brief):
- Manifest: SKU ids, pricing type, CTA URLs, supported regions. Non-compliant fields are the most common blocker.
- Identity docs: company_certificate, DUNS, primary contact verification (we've seen PDF scans that lose metadata; prefer original PDF).
- OAuth: If you use a client_credentials flow, provide client_id + a short test token exchange script. If you use API keys, provide an example header.
- TLS: full chain must be presented and contain a CA that Azure trusts. Wildcard certs are fine but validate SANs.
- Performance: include one request/response sample for a 512-token generation call and note P95.

Attachments (suggested names): tilt_company_certificate.pdf, tilt_duns_document.pdf, redwood_offer_manifest-draft.json, endpoint-compatibility-spec.md, endpoint-sample-request.txt

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tilt-azure-onboarding
Pre-validation turnaround: 48 hours after receipt. If anything fails we’ll list remediation steps and we can open a support escalation with Marketplace Support to shorten the window.

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
